name: Carps & Dragons
description:
In this colorful pond getting lunch is not that hard for Jack and Walter, or is it? Look at those Carps just jumping out of the water! Aren't they a beautiful joy? But, what about the big bad Dragon watching over them?

Play solo or with friends to “Carps & Dragons” frenetic action and solve all the challenging puzzles.

Send your friends a Demo via the Nintendo 3DS Download Play.
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
